blocks.text: -'s va of: egasi kim yoki nima?

-'s ning shakllari (my friend's, my parents', the children's) va asosiy farq — odam uchun -'s, narsa uchun of — qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 64-dars). O'zbekchada esa hamma holatda bitta `-ning` ishlatiladi: «singlimning ismi», «kitobning nomi», «kompaniyaning foydasi», «ertalab qo'ng'iroq qilgan odamning ismi». Inglizchada tanlov bor va u egasiga bog'liq. Bu darsda: qachon faqat bittasi tabiiy, qachon ikkalasi ham mumkin, uzun ifodalar bilan of, vaqt ifodalari (**today's**, **two weeks'**) va uchinchi variant — ot + ot (→ 80-dars).

Egasi odam yoki hayvon bo'lsa, odatda **-'s**: my sister**'s** name, the manager**'s** office, the dog**'s** bowl, Bekzod**'s** idea. Ko'plikda — faqat apostrof: my parents**'** anniversary, the students**'** results; `-s` siz ko'plikda — **'s**: the children**'s** toys, women**'s** rights. «the name of my sister» grammatik jihatdan xato emas, lekin g'ayritabiiy eshitiladi. Ikki bosqichli egalik ham mumkin: my neighbours**'** son**'s** wedding — qo'shnilarimizning o'g'lining to'yi.

items.text: Have you met **Madina's** husband? He's a surgeon at the city hospital.
items.translation: **Madinaning** eri bilan tanishganmisiz? U shahar kasalxonasida jarroh.

items.text: **The cat's** bowl is empty again — has anyone fed her?
items.translation: **Mushukning** idishi yana bo'sh — kimdir uni ovqatlantirdimi?

items.text: **My grandparents'** house is full of old photos.
items.translation: **Bobom va buvimning** uyi eski suratlarga to'la.

blocks.text: Egasi narsa yoki tushuncha bo'lsa — odatda **of**: the end **of** the film, the cause **of** the problem, the top **of** the mountain, the back **of** the room, the beginning **of** the year, the price **of** petrol. «the film's end» — g'ayritabiiy. Ko'pincha uchinchi variant ham bor — **ot + ot** (→ 80-dars), ayniqsa narsaning odatiy qismi haqida: the door of the car → the **car** door, the keys of the house → the **house** keys. O'zbekchadagi «mashina eshigi» ham aynan shunday izofa.

Egasi odam bo'lsa ham, uni uzun ifoda yoki ergash gap bilan tasvirlasak, **of** ishlatiladi — aks holda -'s egasidan juda uzoqda qolib ketadi: What's the name **of the man who called you this morning**? («the man who called you this morning's name» emas). Shuningdek: the son **of a famous Uzbek writer**, the car **of the family next door**, the views **of people who live in the area**. O'zbekchada `-ning` istalgan uzunlikdagi ifodaga qo'shilaveradi, shuning uchun bu yerda o'zbekcha tartibni ko'chirish xatoga olib keladi.

items.text: What's the name **of the woman who interviewed you**?
items.translation: **Siz bilan suhbat o'tkazgan ayolning** ismi nima?

items.text: He's the son **of a famous Uzbek film director**.

blocks.text: Tashkilot, joy, guruh — ikkalasi ham mumkin

Tashkilot, kompaniya, shahar, mamlakat va odamlar guruhi bilan ikkala shakl ham to'g'ri: **the company's** profits = the profits **of the company**; **the government's** decision = the decision **of the government**; **Uzbekistan's** population = the population **of Uzbekistan**; **the city's** museums; **the team's** coach. Orttirma daraja bilan **the world's** juda keng tarqalgan: the world's longest river. Yangiliklar va kundalik nutqda **-'s** qisqa va tabiiy, **of** esa biroz rasmiyroq va urg'uni egaga emas, narsaga qaratadi.

items.text: **The company's** profits have doubled since it started selling online.
items.translation: Onlayn sotuvni boshlaganidan beri **kompaniyaning** foydasi ikki baravar oshdi.

items.text: **Tashkent's** metro is famous for its beautiful stations.
**London's** parks are full of people whenever the sun comes out.
items.translation: Quyosh chiqdi deguncha **Londonning** parklari odamga to'lib ketadi.

blocks.text: Vaqt bilan -'s: today's news, two weeks' holiday

Vaqt ifodalari bilan **-'s** juda ko'p ishlatiladi: **today's** newspaper, **yesterday's** meeting, **tomorrow's** weather, **next week's** exam, **last year's** results, **this month's** salary, **Saturday's** match. O'zbekchada bunga `-gi` bilan yasalgan sifatlar to'g'ri keladi: «bugungi», «kechagi», «ertangi», «o'tgan yilgi». Davomiylik bilan ham shunday: **a day's** work, **a week's** holiday, **an hour's** drive; ko'plikda apostrof `s` dan keyin: **two weeks'** holiday, **ten minutes'** walk, **three years'** experience; **in a week's time** — bir haftadan keyin. Ikki variantni adashtirmang: **two weeks'** holiday (a yo'q, apostrof bor) = **a two-week** holiday (a bor, `-s` yo'q, → 80-dars).

items.text: Did you read **today's** paper? There's an article about our school.
items.translation: **Bugungi** gazetani o'qidingizmi? Unda maktabimiz haqida maqola bor.

items.text: It's only **ten minutes'** walk from here to the Registan.
items.translation: Bu yerdan Registongacha piyoda bor-yo'g'i **o'n daqiqalik** yo'l.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «the name of my sister» → **my sister's name** (tabiiyroq); «the film's end» → **the end of the film**; «the car of my brother» → **my brother's car**; «the man who lives next door's car» → **the car of the man who lives next door**; «today news», «the today's news» → **today's news**; «two weeks holiday» → **two weeks' holiday** yoki **a two-week holiday**; «a two weeks' holiday» → **two weeks' holiday** (a yo'q); «the door of the car» — xato emas, lekin kundalik nutqda **the car door** ko'proq.

Avval egasiga qarang: **odam / hayvon** — -'s; **tashkilot, joy** — -'s yoki of; **narsa** — of yoki ot + ot. Egasi uzun ifoda bilan berilgan bo'lsa — of. O'zbekcha `-gi` qo'shimchali vaqt so'zlari (bugungi, kechagi, ertangi) inglizchada doim **-'s**: today's, yesterday's, tomorrow's.

examples.title: People and animals: **my sister's**, **my parents'**
examples.description: Egasi odam yoki hayvon — -'s; ko'plikda -s'; -s siz ko'plikda -'s (children's, women's).

sentences.text: What's **your sister's** name? I've forgotten it again.
sentences.translation: **Singlingizning** ismi nima edi? Yana unutibman.

sentences.text: **The manager's** office is on the third floor, next to the meeting room.
sentences.translation: **Menejerning** kabineti uchinchi qavatda, majlislar xonasining yonida.

sentences.text: We're organising a surprise party for **my parents'** thirtieth anniversary.
sentences.translation: **Ota-onamning** turmush qurganiga o'ttiz yil to'lishi munosabati bilan kutilmagan ziyofat tayyorlayapmiz.

sentences.text: **The children's** playground was closed after one of the swings broke.
sentences.translation: Arg'imchoqlardan biri singanidan keyin **bolalar** maydonchasi yopildi.

sentences.text: I borrowed **Jasur's** laptop because mine had stopped working.
sentences.translation: Meniki ishlamay qolgani uchun **Jasurning** noutbukini olib turdim.

sentences.text: **The dog's** lead is hanging by the door, if you want to take him out.
sentences.translation: Uni sayrga olib chiqmoqchi bo'lsangiz, **itning** bog'ichi eshik yonida osig'liq turibdi.

sentences.text: Did you see **the students'** faces when the teacher announced a surprise test?
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi kutilmagan test e'lon qilganida **talabalarning** yuzini ko'rdingizmi?

sentences.text: **James's** new girlfriend is a doctor from Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: **Jeymsning** yangi qiz do'sti Edinburglik shifokor.

sentences.text: This shop sells **women's** clothes on the ground floor and **men's** upstairs.
sentences.translation: Bu do'kon birinchi qavatda **ayollar** kiyimini, yuqorida esa **erkaklar** kiyimini sotadi.

sentences.text: **Our neighbours' son's** wedding is next Saturday, and the whole street is invited.
sentences.translation: **Qo'shnilarimizning o'g'lining** to'yi kelasi shanba, butun mahalla taklif qilingan.

examples.title: Things: **the end of the film**, **the top of the page**
examples.description: Egasi narsa yoki tushuncha — odatda **of**: the end of the film, the cause of the problem. «the film's end» g'ayritabiiy.

sentences.text: I fell asleep before **the end of the film**, so tell me what happened.
sentences.translation: **Filmning oxirigacha** uxlab qoldim, nima bo'lganini aytib ber.

sentences.text: Write your name at **the top of the page** and answer all the questions.
sentences.translation: Ismingizni **sahifaning yuqorisiga** yozing va barcha savollarga javob bering.

sentences.text: Nobody knows **the cause of the fire** yet, but the police are investigating.
sentences.translation: **Yong'inning sababi** hali hech kimga ma'lum emas, lekin politsiya tekshiryapti.

sentences.text: We sat at **the back of the bus**, where it was quieter.
sentences.translation: Biz **avtobusning orqa tomonida** o'tirdik, u yer jimroq edi.

sentences.text: **The price of petrol** has gone up three times this year.
sentences.translation: Bu yil **benzin narxi** uch marta oshdi.

sentences.text: From **the top of the mountain** you can see the whole Fergana Valley.
sentences.translation: **Tog'ning cho'qqisidan** butun Farg'ona vodiysini ko'rish mumkin.

sentences.text: Do you know **the name of the hotel** where they're staying?
sentences.translation: Ular to'xtagan **mehmonxonaning nomini** bilasizmi?

sentences.text: At **the beginning of the year**, Madina promised herself she'd learn to swim.
sentences.translation: **Yil boshida** Madina o'ziga suzishni o'rganishga va'da bergan edi.

sentences.text: **The walls of the old city** in Khiva are about ten metres high.
sentences.translation: Xivadagi **qadimiy shahar devorlari** taxminan o'n metr balandlikda.

sentences.text: The meeting was about **the future of the company**, so everyone listened carefully.
sentences.translation: Majlis **kompaniyaning kelajagi** haqida edi, shuning uchun hamma diqqat bilan tingladi.

examples.title: Long phrases: **the name of the man who called**
examples.description: Egasi odam bo'lsa ham, uzun ifoda yoki ergash gap bilan tasvirlansa — **of**. O'zbekchada -ning har qanday uzun ifodaga qo'shiladi.

sentences.text: What's the name **of the man who called** while I was out?
sentences.translation: Men yo'qligimda **qo'ng'iroq qilgan odamning** ismi nima?

sentences.text: Sarah is the daughter **of a well-known heart surgeon** in London.
sentences.translation: Sara Londondagi **taniqli yurak jarrohining** qizi.

sentences.text: I can't remember the address **of the friend we stayed with** in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Buxoroda uyida qolgan **do'stimizning** manzilini eslay olmayapman.

sentences.text: For a whole week the car **of the family next door** has been blocking our gate.
sentences.translation: Butun bir hafta **qo'shni oilaning** mashinasi darvozamizni to'sib turibdi.

sentences.text: We need to hear the opinions **of people who actually live in the area**.
sentences.translation: **Shu hududda haqiqatan yashaydigan odamlarning** fikrini eshitishimiz kerak.

sentences.text: Somewhere in my bag I've got the phone number **of the woman who sold us the flat**.
sentences.translation: Sumkamning bir joyida **bizga kvartira sotgan ayolning** telefon raqami bor.

sentences.text: Do you know the name **of the actor who played the king**?
sentences.translation: **Podsho rolini ijro etgan aktyorning** ismini bilasizmi?

sentences.text: They interviewed the parents **of the students who won the competition**.
sentences.translation: Ular **tanlovda g'olib bo'lgan talabalarning** ota-onalaridan intervyu olishdi.

sentences.text: The success **of the young team from Fergana** surprised everybody.
sentences.translation: **Farg'onalik yosh jamoaning** muvaffaqiyati hammani hayratda qoldirdi.

sentences.text: The wife **of the man who runs the bakery** makes the best samsa in town.
sentences.translation: **Novvoyxonani yurituvchi odamning** xotini shahardagi eng mazali somsani pishiradi.

examples.title: Organisations and places: **the company's**, **Tashkent's**
examples.description: Tashkilot, kompaniya, shahar, mamlakat va guruhlar bilan ikkala shakl ham to'g'ri: the company's profits = the profits of the company. Yangiliklarda -'s qisqaroq.

sentences.text: **The company's** profits fell sharply after the new tax was introduced.
sentences.translation: Yangi soliq joriy etilgandan keyin **kompaniyaning** foydasi keskin tushib ketdi.

sentences.text: Taxi drivers are angry about **the government's** decision to raise fuel prices.
sentences.translation: Taksi haydovchilari **hukumatning** yoqilg'i narxini oshirish haqidagi qaroridan norozi.

sentences.text: **Uzbekistan's** population has grown to more than thirty-six million.
sentences.translation: **O'zbekiston** aholisi o'ttiz olti milliondan oshdi.

sentences.text: **Samarkand's** most famous square, the Registan, is beautifully lit up at night.
sentences.translation: **Samarqandning** eng mashhur maydoni — Registon kechasi chiroyli yoritiladi.

sentences.text: Since he arrived, **the team's** new coach has completely changed the way they play.
sentences.translation: Kelganidan beri **jamoaning** yangi murabbiyi ularning o'yin uslubini butunlay o'zgartirib yubordi.

sentences.text: Lake Baikal, **the world's** deepest lake, is more than 1,600 metres deep in places.
sentences.translation: **Dunyodagi** eng chuqur ko'l — Baykalning chuqurligi ba'zi joylarda 1600 metrdan oshadi.

sentences.text: The success **of the company** depends on how quickly it can adapt to new technology.
sentences.translation: **Kompaniyaning** muvaffaqiyati uning yangi texnologiyalarga qanchalik tez moslasha olishiga bog'liq.

sentences.text: According to **the bank's** website, the branch on Navoi Street closes at five.
sentences.translation: **Bankning** saytiga ko'ra, Navoiy ko'chasidagi filial soat beshda yopiladi.

sentences.text: Is **London's** underground older than **Tashkent's**? — Yes, by more than a hundred years.
sentences.translation: **London** metrosi **Toshkentnikidan** qadimiyroqmi? — Ha, yuz yildan ham ko'proq.

sentences.text: During the exam period **the university's** library is open twenty-four hours a day.
sentences.translation: Imtihonlar davrida **universitetning** kutubxonasi kecha-kunduz ochiq.

examples.title: Time: **today's news**, **next week's exam**
examples.description: Vaqt nuqtasi bilan -'s: today's, yesterday's, tomorrow's, next week's, last year's. O'zbekchadagi «bugungi», «kechagi», «ertangi».

sentences.text: Have you seen **today's** headlines? Everyone's talking about the new metro line.
sentences.translation: **Bugungi** sarlavhalarni ko'rdingizmi? Hamma yangi metro liniyasi haqida gapiryapti.

sentences.text: **Yesterday's** meeting went on for three hours, and we still didn't decide anything.
sentences.translation: **Kechagi** majlis uch soat davom etdi, lekin baribir hech narsani hal qilmadik.

sentences.text: According to **tomorrow's** forecast, it's going to snow in the mountains.
sentences.translation: **Ertangi** ob-havo ma'lumotiga ko'ra, tog'larda qor yog'adi.

sentences.text: I'm really nervous about **next week's** exam, so I'm revising every evening.
sentences.translation: **Kelasi haftadagi** imtihondan juda xavotirdaman, shuning uchun har kechqurun takrorlayapman.

sentences.text: **Last year's** results were disappointing, but this year things look much better.
sentences.translation: **O'tgan yilgi** natijalar umidsizlantiruvchi edi, lekin bu yil vaziyat ancha yaxshi ko'rinyapti.

sentences.text: Most of **this month's** salary went on the car repairs.
sentences.translation: **Shu oygi** maoshimning katta qismi mashina ta'miriga ketdi.

sentences.text: Did you watch **Saturday's** match between Pakhtakor and Navbahor?
sentences.translation: Paxtakor va Navbahor o'rtasidagi **shanbadagi** o'yinni ko'rdingizmi?

sentences.text: **This morning's** flight to Bukhara was cancelled because of fog.
sentences.translation: **Bugun ertalabki** Buxoro reysi tuman sababli bekor qilindi.

sentences.text: We're still talking about **last night's** concert — it was absolutely brilliant.
sentences.translation: **Kecha kechqurungi** konsert haqida hali ham gaplashyapmiz — u juda ajoyib edi.

sentences.text: Unlike **yesterday's** weather, **today's** is perfect for a picnic by the lake.
sentences.translation: **Kechagi** havodan farqli o'laroq, **bugungisi** ko'l bo'yida piknik uchun juda mos.

examples.title: Duration: **two weeks' holiday**, **a day's work**
examples.description: Davomiylik bilan -'s: a day's work, an hour's flight; ko'plikda apostrof s dan keyin: two weeks' holiday. Ot + ot bilan taqqoslang: a two-week holiday (→ 80-dars).

sentences.text: I'm entitled to **four weeks'** holiday a year, but I rarely take it all.
sentences.translation: Yiliga **to'rt haftalik** ta'tilga haqqim bor, lekin kamdan-kam hammasini olaman.

sentences.text: Samarkand is about **an hour's** flight from Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Samarqand Toshkentdan taxminan **bir soatlik** parvoz uzoqligida.

sentences.text: After **a hard day's** work, there's nothing better than a cup of green tea.
sentences.translation: **Og'ir kunlik** mehnatdan keyin bir piyola ko'k choydan yaxshiroq narsa yo'q.

sentences.text: The job requires at least **three years'** experience in marketing.
sentences.translation: Bu ish marketing sohasida kamida **uch yillik** tajribani talab qiladi.

sentences.text: The hotel is only **five minutes'** walk from the beach.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona plyajdan bor-yo'g'i **besh daqiqalik** piyoda yo'lda.

sentences.text: I'll finish the report **in a week's time**, I promise.
sentences.translation: Hisobotni **bir haftadan keyin** tugataman, va'da beraman.

sentences.text: Kate took **a month's** unpaid leave to look after her mother.
sentences.translation: Keyt onasiga qarash uchun **bir oylik** maoshsiz ta'til oldi.

sentences.text: Instead of **two weeks'** holiday in Turkey, we went on **a two-week** tour of Uzbekistan.
sentences.translation: Turkiyada **ikki haftalik** dam olish o'rniga O'zbekiston bo'ylab **ikki haftalik** sayohatga chiqdik.

sentences.text: How much is **a night's** stay at that hotel near the Registan?
sentences.translation: Registon yaqinidagi o'sha mehmonxonada **bir kechalik** turish qancha turadi?

sentences.text: Nilufar only got **four hours'** sleep before the exam, and she could hardly concentrate.
sentences.translation: Nilufar imtihondan oldin bor-yo'g'i **to'rt soat** uxladi va diqqatini zo'rg'a jamlay oldi.

examples.title: **-'s**, **of** or noun + noun?
examples.description: Uch xil ifodani tanlash: odam — -'s, narsaning odatiy qismi — ot + ot (the car door), boshqa narsa va tushunchalar — of.

sentences.text: The **car door** won't close properly — I think the lock is broken.
sentences.translation: **Mashina eshigi** yaxshi yopilmayapti — menimcha, qulfi buzilgan.

sentences.text: **Aziz's** car is the blue one parked next to **the school gate**.
sentences.translation: **Azizning** mashinasi — **maktab darvozasi** yonida turgan ko'k mashina.

sentences.text: In the storm **the roof of the house** was damaged, so we're staying with **my sister's** family.
sentences.translation: Bo'ronda **uyning tomi** shikastlandi, shuning uchun **opamning** oilasinikida turibmiz.

sentences.text: Have you seen **the kitchen scissors**? They're not in the drawer.
sentences.translation: **Oshxona qaychisini** ko'rdingizmi? Tortmada yo'q.

sentences.text: **The cost of living** in London is much higher than in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Londonda **yashash narxi** Toshkentdagidan ancha baland.

sentences.text: **Bekzod's** idea was simple: sell **the company's** products online.
sentences.translation: **Bekzodning** g'oyasi oddiy edi: **kompaniya** mahsulotlarini onlayn sotish.

sentences.text: My phone was at **the bottom of my bag**, under all **the children's** snacks.
sentences.translation: Telefonim **sumkamning tagida**, **bolalarning** yeguliklari ostida ekan.

sentences.text: Put **the dog's** food next to **the back door**, please.
sentences.translation: **Itning** ovqatini **orqa eshik** yoniga qo'ying, iltimos.

sentences.text: Chapter one **of the book** explains **the city's** early history.
sentences.translation: **Kitobning** birinchi bobi **shaharning** ilk tarixini tushuntiradi.

sentences.text: At **the end of the street**, turn left and you'll see **my parents'** house.
sentences.translation: **Ko'chaning oxirida** chapga buriling, **ota-onamning** uyini ko'rasiz.

examples.title: Dialogue: back at work after a wedding
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: ikki hamkasb to'ydan keyingi birinchi ish kunida gaplashadi — odam, vaqt, tashkilot va narsalar bilan -'s va of.

sentences.text: — Welcome back! How was **your brother's** wedding in Samarkand?
sentences.translation: — Xush kelibsan! **Akangning** Samarqanddagi to'yi qanday o'tdi?

sentences.text: — Wonderful, but after **three days'** celebrations I need another holiday!
sentences.translation: — Ajoyib, lekin **uch kunlik** bazmdan keyin menga yana bitta ta'til kerak!

sentences.text: — I can imagine. Did you see **today's** email from **the manager's** assistant?
sentences.translation: — Tasavvur qilaman. **Menejerning** yordamchisidan kelgan **bugungi** xatni ko'rdingmi?

sentences.text: — Not yet. Is it about **next week's** meeting with the new client?
sentences.translation: — Hali yo'q. **Kelasi haftadagi** yangi mijoz bilan uchrashuv haqidami?

sentences.text: — Yes, and they want **the results of the survey** by Friday.
sentences.translation: — Ha, ular **so'rovnoma natijalarini** jumagacha so'rashyapti.

sentences.text: — By Friday? That's **a week's** work at least!
sentences.translation: — Jumagachami? Bu kamida **bir haftalik** ish-ku!

sentences.text: — Don't worry, **Emma's** team has already done half of it.
sentences.translation: — Xavotir olma, **Emmaning** jamoasi yarmini allaqachon qilib qo'ydi.

sentences.text: — Great. Are the files on **the company's** shared drive, as usual?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r. Fayllar odatdagidek **kompaniyaning** umumiy diskidami?

sentences.text: — Yes, in the folder with **last year's** reports, at **the top of the list**.
sentences.translation: — Ha, **o'tgan yilgi** hisobotlar papkasida, **ro'yxatning boshida**.

sentences.text: — Perfect. Now tell me everything about **the bride's** dress and **the wedding cake**!
sentences.translation: — Ajoyib. Endi menga **kelinning** libosi va **to'y torti** haqida hammasini gapirib ber!
